protocol.filter: window-reset causal SOS 1-45Hz order4 + 50Hz notch Q30
protocol.wavelet: db4 wavedec level5 zero extension; endpoint output, boundary coefficients retained
protocol.timefreq: Hann STFT 1s, hop0.5s, boundary=None, padded=False; log-power and relative bandpower mean/std/slope/max/min
protocol.quality53: existing artifact comparator: causal_features(causal_filter(x)) + 9 raw quality metrics
protocol.classifier: VarianceThreshold + StandardScaler + optional SelectKBest(f_classif,k=30) + balanced LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=2000)
protocol.leakage: all transforms fit only on training fold; all signal features emitted at six-second endpoint
protocol.polarization: not applicable: single channel has no 2D/spatial polarization or multichannel covariance
protocol.hilbert: not implemented; baseline44 already includes spectral entropy and centroid
protocol.selection_caveat: best of these outer CV comparisons is exploratory, not independent test accuracy
